{{Top|leg}}
The '''Great Ritual''' was a ceremony practiced on rare occasions amongst the [[Tarasin]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. When the entire Tarasin civilization was threatened the Ritual, which involved a call to all [[irstat]] leaders to come together to discuss the fate of the Tarasin. Until the threat had passed, the Ritual would not break, thereby promising the survival of the race.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the last known Great Ritual was called by Mother [[Dariana]] of the [[Hiironi irstat]]. The Ritual was proven well called for when the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] was placed under martial law, and the Tarasin were forced to flee the planet.
